message_signing_initial.fix_status: A narrowly gated compatibility fix is prepared; verification on a newly labelled exact-source artifact is still required.

privacy: Raw JWTs, keys, codes, identities, suite exports and response bodies remain in private ignored runtime artifacts; only module names/statuses are published.

message_signing_typ_compatibility_run.assessment: The full 70-module plan executed. Valid signed request-object flows now pass. Two failures remain: the opted-in FAPI browser missing-PAR path returned JSON rather than the expected local HTML error page; a request_uri claim inside a signed request object returned invalid_request instead of invalid_request_object. RFC 9101 section 4 forbids both request and request_uri inside signed Request Objects. Narrow fixes and regressions are prepared; a final exact-source runtime rerun remains required.
